tools.name: submit_project
tools.description: Create a private project draft. No signup. Save the returned control token securely. Reuse the same random idempotency key for retries. Optional listing fields (tagline, long_description, audience, not_for, screenshots, video_url, pricing, platforms, links, mcp_url, openapi_url, app_store_url, play_

tools.name: get_submission
tools.description: Read private status, listing completeness, suggested faq_questions, the private agent-readiness report, and exact next actions.

tools.name: verify_submission
tools.description: Request website and badge verification. Call after installing the returned snippet or file.

tools.name: update_submission
tools.description: Update the name, description, or any listing field. Send null to remove a field. Changes run the automatic checks again; the listing stays in review until they pass.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: Browse published projects only. Use page to read more results.

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: Read one published listing by slug or listing ID: description, FAQ, pricing, platforms, links, screenshots, verified store and GitHub data, and passed agent-readiness checks.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List every valid category ID, name, and alias. Choose one primary category.

tools.name: list_tags
tools.description: List all valid tag IDs, names, and aliases. Submit suggestions as comma-separated values.

tools.name: get_taxonomy
tools.description: Read valid category and tag IDs.

tools.name: recover_submission
tools.description: Recover a lost control token by proving website control. First omit recovery_id, save the new token, and install the returned file. Then call again with recovery_id. Never share tokens publicly.

tools.name: get_badge
tools.description: Get the public badge snippet for any submission. No control token required. Installing it on the submitted website proves control.

tools.name: purchase_badge_waiver
tools.description: Anyone may pay the $4.99 badge waiver for an eligible submission after website and content verification. No submission control token is needed. Use checkout for a hosted Managed Checkout link. Use mpp with an authorized MPP payment client for a direct payment sold by submitby.ai, outside Managed Pay
